title: Case: Failed delivery has returned to sender and the customer still wants the order
context: The failed original delivery is physically back at the merchant. The recipient still wants the item and has confirmed the existing delivery details.
initial_request:
I still want the order. I checked my authenticated order details: Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk, Merrow Quay is correct. Please ask for reshipment there.

If this is not sorted by Friday I am instructing my solicitor and reporting you to Trading Standards.

events.body: DL-3742 for TG-2550 is physically back in our stock after failed delivery and return-to-sender. Item accepted as reshippable. Our account team has authenticated Rosalind’s order-portal session; stored destination is Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk, Merrow Quay. A new dispatch requires merchant approval.

I still want the order. I checked my authenticated order details: Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk, Merrow Quay is correct. Please ask for reshipment there.

If this is not sorted by Friday I am instructing my solicitor and reporting you to Trading Standards.

must: Hands the case to a human supervisor with the facts, including the legal threat
must_not: Admits fault or liability, or offers compensation
Sends the customer a message that commits the desk to an outcome, date or payment
New shipment reference does not prove dispatch or receipt; do not reuse the old delivered status.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-038: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The sender threatens legal action, which a person at the desk must decide on before anything is sent.
